name: @cosmic-coffeehouse/e2e-tests
description: End-to-End testing suite with Playwright and BDD for The Cosmic Coffeehouse

scripts.test: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts
scripts.test:smoke: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts --grep @smoke
scripts.test:smoke:chromium: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts --grep @smoke --project=chromium
scripts.test:smoke:headed: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts --grep @smoke --project=chromium --headed
scripts.test:regression: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts --grep @regression
scripts.test:critical: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts --grep @critical
scripts.test:headed: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts --headed
scripts.test:debug: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts --debug --project=chromium
scripts.test:debug:headed: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts --debug --headed --project=chromium
scripts.test:trace: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts --trace on
scripts.test:ui: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts --ui
scripts.test:slow: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts --timeout=60000 --slow-mo=1000
scripts.test:auth: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts user-authentication.feature.spec.js
scripts.test:ecommerce: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts e-commerce-workflow.feature.spec.js
scripts.test:performance: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts performance.feature.spec.js
scripts.test:health: npm run bddgen && npx playwright test -c playwright-bdd.config.ts system-health.feature.spec.js
scripts.setup: npm run install:deps && npm run install:browsers

author: Antonio Gomez Gallardo
